title: Loop cut

initial.text: A mesh can only bend where it has edges. Loop Cut adds a ring of edges all the way around, exactly where you need more detail.

steps.text: Edge select mode: a loop cut is made of edges.
Edge ▸ Loop Cut and Slide. Now Blender waits for a click on an edge.
Click a side edge. A new ring of edges goes around the barrel, across that edge.
In Adjust Last Operation, set Number of Cuts to 2: two evenly spaced rings.
Both new rings are selected. Mesh ▸ Transform ▸ Scale them, with Shift Z so only X and Y change.
And Scale Y to 1.25: the middle bulges into a barrel.

outro: Loop cuts add detail exactly where a shape needs to bend.
